findings.title: Concealed pursuit makes provision visible
findings.claim: Within the pericope, the feeding named in 90:14 can also be seen as provision reached through concealed, patient pursuit.
findings.mechanism: The focus food occurrence meets the stalking, concealment, waiting, and prey-yielding images attached to 90:12-13, so delayed pursuit becomes a route toward the provision that is finally given.
findings.reader_payoff: The delay and hidden effort behind provision become perceptible inside the short feeding alternative.
findings.containment: The ordinary act of feeding on a famine day remains intact. This is a local pericope hunting image, not a literal claim that 90:14 describes a hunt or that hunting is a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and its anchors agree with supplied pericope occurrences, while the context projection does not provide full lexical morphology for the nominated context branches.

findings.title: Circulation opposes sealed stock
findings.claim: Feeding can also be seen as opening stored livelihood toward circulation before protected possession becomes a destructive enclosure.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace places the focus provision facet beside fire and tight closure in 90:20 and an attributed stone wealth-store image; the outward movement of food is set against stock sealed inside an enclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The act gains an economic contour: provision is valuable here because it leaves containment and reaches another person.
findings.containment: The plain command to give food remains intact. This is an exploratory attributed reversal, not a claim that the final fire is only economic imagery or that 90:14 literally names a store.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates and focus return are exact, but the reconstructed trace is legacy-unbound and its material reversal is explicitly exploratory.

findings.reader_payoff: Feeding becomes perceptible as the end of an ecological process, not only the instant when prepared food changes hands.
findings.containment: The ordinary act of feeding remains the focus gloss. This is an exploratory ecological analogy, explicitly bounded to the supplied ripening branch and famine condition; it does not assert that every food word names plant production.

epistemic.reason: The outlier has exact supplied coordinates and a focus return, but it is a legacy-unbound reconstructed trace and the packet itself marks the cross-domain inference exploratory.

findings.containment: This is an external overlay only. It does not claim that 90:14 itself names judgment, does not replace the native pericope readings, and does not treat 1:2-1:7 as a whole-surah interpretation.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and its exact facet are supplied by trusted packet evidence, while 1:4 contributes a separately supplied surface trigger; the overlay is kept distinct from Phase 1.
